peasant.Name: Peasant Barricade
peasant.Desc: +10 to Strength-based tests and Parry. Immune to Prone. You may take a blow aimed at an adjacent ally on your own guard without a roll.

court.Name: Nuln Fencer
court.Desc: +10 to Initiative and Agility. Every clean successful parry grants +1 extra Advantage. Attacks from surprise ignore the enemy's Armour Points.

gutter.Name: Alley Cardsharp
gutter.Desc: No penalties for improvised weapons, knives and main gauches. All Dirty Tricks cost 1 Advantage less.
gutter.Bonus: Improvised weapons without penalty, Dirty Tricks 1 A cheaper

act-taunt-1.Name: Cold Mockery
act-taunt-1.Effect: The enemy loses 1 Advantage (+1 per 2 SL of difference) and focuses their next attack on you alone. On failure: the Advantage is lost.

act-taunt-2.Name: Feigned Weakness
act-taunt-2.Effect: You fake a stumble. The enemy charges with +10, but if you parry that blow the opponent immediately becomes Surprised. Failure: the enemy gains +1 Advantage.

act-riposte-1.Name: Nuln Riposte
act-riposte-1.Effect: An immediate counter-attack after a successful parry with +10 to hit. Deals normal damage with the Fast quality.

act-riposte-2.Name: Hilt Catch (Bind)
act-riposte-2.Effect: You lock the enemy's blade. The rival's weapon is Trapped – the enemy cannot attack or parry with it until they spend an action on a Strength test.

act-riposte-3.Name: Step Behind
act-riposte-3.Effect: A smooth pass in melee. You gain a flanking position (+20 to your next attack) and the enemy loses 1 Advantage from disorientation.

act-trick-1.Name: Sand and Sewage
act-trick-1.Test: Agility vs enemy's Dodge (a helmet gives +20)
act-trick-1.Effect: Dust thrown in the eyes. The opponent gains 1 Blinded Condition. Failure: no effect, the Advantage is lost.

act-trick-2.Name: Tendon Stamp
act-trick-2.Test: Melee / Strength vs enemy's Dodge / Strength
act-trick-2.Effect: A foot sweep or a kick to the knee. The opponent becomes Prone. On failure: the Champion loses balance (−10 to defence until the end of the round).

act-trick-3.Name: Pommel to the Teeth
act-trick-3.Effect: A pommel strike with the Pummel quality. If it deals at least 1 Wound after armour, the enemy must pass an Endurance test or become Stunned.

act-finisher-1.Name: Cheek Cut (Humiliation)
act-finisher-1.Test: Melee (−20, target: face) vs Melee / Dodge
act-finisher-1.Effect: Deals 1–2 Wounds. The enemy must immediately pass a Difficult (−10) Cool test. On failure: loses 2 Advantage, becomes Broken and loses face at court. On success: falls into a Frenzy.

act-finisher-2.Name: Masterful Disarm (Nuln Flick)
act-finisher-2.Effect: Needs at least +2 SL in the opposed test. The enemy's weapon flies 1d10 m through the air. The enemy is disarmed and must give ground or reach for a knife.

act-finisher-3.Name: Breaking Beheading
act-finisher-3.Test: Intimidate (+10 per critical wound) vs enemies' Cool
act-finisher-3.Effect: After slaying the enemy leader: every subordinate within the Champion's Willpower range tests Cool against your SL or Panics / Flees.

court-middenheim.Name: Court of Middenheim
court-middenheim.Desc: City of the White Wolf. Stern aristocracy, intrigues of the Law Lords, priests of Ulric and the constant shadow of carnival plots.

court-nuln.Name: Court of Nuln
court-nuln.Desc: Jewel of the South, ruled by Countess Emmanuelle. A realm of fashion, rapier duels, cannon and university intrigue.

pin-1.Name: Graf Boris Todbringer
pin-1.Hooks: I know about his worsening state of mind and the visits of a suspicious physician from Altdorf.
pin-1.Notes: Grants private audiences and protection from the accusations of the Law Lords.

pin-2.Name: Baron Heinrich von Todbringer
pin-2.Hooks: I saved his life and reputation in a disputed duel with an Ostland swordsman during the carnival.
pin-2.Notes: Young and hot-headed, but ready to vouch for us before the City Council.

pin-3.Name: Gotthard von Witgenstein
pin-3.Hooks: I know the details of his shady dealings with the merchants' guild and his contacts with dubious types from the docks.
pin-3.Notes: He hates me, but must yield as long as I hold the evidence.

pin-4.Name: Countess Emmanuelle von Liebwitz
pin-4.Hooks: She likes to surround herself with unusual people from the provinces, as long as they bring her renown and elegance at balls.
pin-4.Notes: Her favour opens the doors to the cannon foundries and fencing schools.

pin-5.Name: Don Esteban de la Vega
pin-5.Hooks: He never forgave me for winning on the river pier; he seeks an official rematch.
pin-5.Notes: Superb with a rapier, knows every fencing master from Nuln to Altdorf.

Defaults.ChallengeStakes: Release of the prisoner and a public withdrawal of the accusations
Defaults.ChallengeConditions: To first blood, on trodden ground, steel only
